title: Schema for the mission rewards data file: what each mission gives (cards or credits)

mission_id.description: Foreign key to the mission in data/missions.json (the index).

content_type.description: The reward's collection, or null when the reward is credits.

content_id.description: The reward's id in that collection, or null when the reward is credits.

credits.description: Whether the reward is credits (no card).

choice.description: Whether the reward is one of the mission's alternatives: of its rows with choice true, the player picks one. Rows with choice false are all received.
